abi_facts.clip callbacks: modeled callback signatures are suite callsite/stack captures only; not assertions about unrelated source declarations.
abi_facts.direct: DOS target has no stack input; it reads render/map state from globals and returns far.
abi_facts.f_1CE2_0410: original callback consumes 3 stack words: far Rect pointer at BP+6 and width at BP+0A, RETF without callee pop.
abi_facts.win_IsWinOpen: original f_22BF_09B0 takes the window handle in AX, no stack args; entry `mov bx,ax`, far return.

limitations: The modeled clip callbacks record ordered calls and values; they do not execute clip_SetWin/Push/Pop bodies or simulate clip geometry. XOR draw is an ordered host command only; no pixels/framebuffer. win_IsWinOpen did execute the original body with AX, and valid-open/closed/absent/stale fixtures capture its Ralloc/handle-table effects.
Finite directed/random domain only; not universal proof.
No registry or canonical source modified.
